fields.description: A submission left in Transcribing or Scoring longer than this is treated as abandoned by a dead worker and re-queued. Must stay well above the real processing time, or a slow run is mistaken for a dead one.
fields.label: Re-queue Stalled Submissions After (minutes)

fields.description: Ek-2 retention matrix. Set a value to 0 to keep that data indefinitely.
fields.label: Retention (Ek-2)

fields.description: Speaking transcripts are cleared after this many days; scores are kept.
fields.label: Transcript Retention (days)

fields.description: Completed placement attempts are deleted after this many days.
fields.label: Exam Result Retention (days)

fields.description: Search over the question bank and speaking transcripts (§8.10). 'Database' queries the tables directly and needs no infrastructure; 'OpenSearch' scales further but keeps a copy of privileged data in a cluster.
fields.label: Search

fields.description: Indices are named <prefix>-<site>-<source>, so tenants never share one.
fields.label: Index Prefix

fields.description: Sign requests with the task role instead of storing credentials.
fields.label: Authenticate with IAM

fields.description: Enterprise video protection (§4.4.3). Off = MVP tier: CloudFront signed cookies. Enabling requires a third-party DRM licence agreement, which §1.2 places outside the delivery scope.
fields.label: DRM (Enterprise)

fields.description: MediaPackage packaging group domain (Terraform output drm.packaging_group_domain_name).
fields.label: MediaPackage Domain

fields.description: Playback tokens are shareable, so keep this short. Clamped to 30-3600 seconds.
fields.label: Playback Token TTL (seconds)

fields.description: Vendor licence server. Players never call this directly — requests are proxied so entitlement is checked first.
fields.label: Licence Server URL

fields.description: Draws a per-viewer code over the player so a screen recording traces back to whoever made it (§1.1 copying deterrence). Independent of DRM. True forensic (in-essence) watermarking is a Premium vendor option — see docs/watermarking.md.
fields.label: Session Watermark

fields.description: Optional text before the code, e.g. the institution name. Never put personal data here — the overlay is visible to anyone watching the screen.
fields.label: Label Prefix

fields.description: Percent. Too faint is unreadable in a recording; too strong makes the lesson unpleasant. Clamped to 15-80.
fields.label: Opacity (%)

fields.description: How often the mark jumps position. A static mark is simply cropped out.
fields.label: Move Interval (seconds)

fields.description: Sessions record IP and user agent, so they are personal data. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
fields.label: Session Retention (days)

fields.description: Business continuity targets and evidence (§6.1, §8.18). The dates below are what makes the restore-test MUST auditable rather than assumed.
fields.label: Disaster Recovery

fields.description: DR region, when cross-region replication is enabled (§8.1 suggests eu-west-1). Blank means single-region.
fields.label: DR Region

fields.description: §6.1 states 15 min - 1 hour. Backups older than this are reported as a breach.
fields.label: RPO Target (minutes)

fields.description: §6.1 states 1-4 hours. Used to build the failover phase budget.
fields.label: RTO Target (hours)

fields.description: How often a backup must actually be restored and verified (§8.18 MUST).
fields.label: Restore Test Interval (days)

fields.description: Set by record_restore_test, and only on a pass. A failed test deliberately leaves this untouched.
fields.label: Last Successful Restore Test

fields.description: Set by record_dr_drill. §8.18 asks for at least one a year.
fields.label: Last DR Drill
